#!/bin/bash

# Post-receive hook for automatic deployment
# Deploy main and dev branches to separate directories

REPO_DIR="/git/project"
DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/git-deploy"
WORK_DIR="/tmp/git-deploy-$$"

mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
trap "rm -rf $WORK_DIR" EXIT

# Deploy each branch
for BRANCH in main dev; do
    if git -C "$REPO_DIR" rev-parse --verify "$BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # Check out the branch to a temporary directory
        git -C "$REPO_DIR" worktree add "$WORK_DIR/$BRANCH" "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || \
            git --work-tree="$WORK_DIR/$BRANCH" --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" checkout -f "$BRANCH"

        # Copy the content to the deployment directory
        if [ -d "$WORK_DIR/$BRANCH" ]; then
            rm -rf "$DEPLOY_DIR/$BRANCH"/*
            cp -r "$WORK_DIR/$BRANCH"/* "$DEPLOY_DIR/$BRANCH/" 2>/dev/null || true
            # Clean up worktree if it exists
            git -C "$REPO_DIR" worktree remove "$WORK_DIR/$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
done

exit 0
